name: Coordinate-Time Encoding
definition: An encoding scheme that concatenates interpolated features with positionally encoded coordinates and temporal embeddings to enhance temporal information and handle dynamic light sources in in vivo sequences, replacing standard positional encoding of viewing directions.
summary: Coordinate-Time Encoding is a continuous, single-scale method that rasterizes a Gaussian kernel to map bounded coordinates into a higher-dimensional space, offering localized accuracy unlike multi-frequency approaches.
